This revalidation moves the drift anchor to main@3f472e6d and applies exactly the status transitions the ROUND_004_AMENDMENTS demand: both basis-expanded packets are BLOCKED_BASIS_EXPANDED with their replacement families (navigation_dependency_tracked_incremental_v4, path_reduction_with_verified_nogoods_v4) and the new candidate packet is ACTIVE. The other two round004 basis expansions (verified_solver_compilation_snapshot_v2, mechanic_predictive_hierarchical_controller_v3) name packets not present in this registry, so no registry entry exists to update for them. This revalidation grants no benefit, promotion or scientific authority; ACTIVE only means the ordinary promotion gate may evaluate evidence. The exact-head drift preflight fails closed if any tracked knowledge-basis path changes after this anchor, so a later saturation round cannot silently leave stale ACTIVE statuses eligible.
